item.title: Acme Foods Recalls Bagged Spinach Due to Listeria
item.description: Acme Foods of Salinas, CA is recalling bagged spinach because it may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Sunrise Dairy Allergy Alert on Undeclared Milk in Ice Cream
item.description: Sunrise Dairy is recalling cartons of vanilla ice cream because they contain undeclared milk.
item.dc:creator: FDA
